title: A Uniform for the Ledger
author: Wren Hartwell
blurb: Yara Blackwood, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
